english.title: Person working for / on behalf of relevant supervisory authority disclose confidential information
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 52B(1) and (2) of the Money Laundering Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person working for / acting on behalf of relevant supervisory authority OR
person who has worked / acted on behalf of relevant supervisory authority
disclosed confidential information
received during the course of their duties under the Money Laundering Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017
not in accordance with regulation 52B of those Regulations

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It is a defence under regulation 52B(3) for the accused to prove that he/she did not know and had no reason to suspect that the information was confidential information; and that he/she took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:
None
